title: Eraser under-erases when the stroke crosses a shape's boundary edge (follow-up to 1263)
description:
FOLLOW-UP to 1263 (eraser vector-subtract; commit f2753b0). The 1263 headline fix is VERIFIED at runtime: the eraser no longer deletes the whole shape. But a partial defect remains — an eraser stroke that CROSSES the shape's boundary edge (the task's own case 'a': 'erase a notch from an edge') removes NOTHING; the geometry is returned unchanged and onShapeUpdate is never effectively applied.

RUNTIME EVIDENCE (interactive Playwright drive of the real editor via __flashTest, loadDocument a 200x200 solid black rect at stage (60,60)-(260,260), select eraser (default size 16), drag, then measure black pixels via screenshotStage and read back doc geometry):
- INTERIOR stroke (horizontal band at y=90, fully inside): WORKS — dark 40000 -> 38992 (removed 1008), shape split into 138 paths (holed tunnel). Correct vector subtract.
- LEFT vertical edge (x=60, y 120->200): WORKS — removed 700 px, notch carved.
- TOP edge cases ALL no-op (removed 0, paths stay 1, darkPx unchanged 40000):
  * eraser centered exactly on top edge y=60 (x 130->190)
  * just-inside y=68 (disk spans y 60-76, clearly overlaps interior by ~8px)
  * diagonal stroke entering across the top edge (100,40)->(160,90)
  * slightly-slanted top-edge stroke (120,64)->(200,70)
  * short stab from outside into the top edge (150,45)->(150,75)
  * big notch sweeping along the top edge to the corner (60,60)->(160,60)

PATTERN: strokes that lie fully in the interior subtract correctly; strokes whose eraser disk crosses/straddles the top horizontal boundary edge subtract nothing. The left vertical edge worked, so it is edge-orientation/tangency-specific, most likely a Greiner-Hormann degeneracy (clip boundary near-collinear/tangent with the subject's top edge) where subtractPolygon's 'looksSane' guard + perturbation retries end up rejecting the cut and returning the subject unchanged (subtractPolygon in packages/core/src/engine/eraser.ts, ~lines 437-468). The interior case crosses no subject edge so it is unaffected.

IMPACT: the primary authoring gesture for the eraser — carving a notch/bite from the OUTSIDE edge of a fill — does nothing on the top edge of an axis-aligned rect, so erasing 'feels broken' for the common case even though it never deletes the whole shape.

SCOPE: packages/core/src/engine/eraser.ts (subtractPolygon degeneracy handling for tangent/edge-crossing clips) + regression cases in eraser.test.ts covering an eraser disk that straddles a subject edge from outside (assert area is reduced, not unchanged). No StageArea change expected (the handler already calls eraseShape correctly; interior erases prove the wiring works).

ACCEPTANCE: a horizontal eraser band crossing the top edge of a filled rect reduces its filled area (darkPx drops) and reshapes/splits the path; verify the same interactively via the real editor (not unit-only) since 1263's unit tests passed while this case failed at runtime.

Regression suites confirmed green at the time of filing (HEAD 8d2c2cf): smoke 3, agent-mcp 22, visual-oracle 13 all pass; off-stage pasteboard (1273) fully verified (render+select+move).
